description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to timestamps in the utils package, verifying timestamp comparison, date conversion, and Data Studio datetime formatting.

methods.name: TestTimestampSeconds
methods.description: Tests that the TimestampSeconds function generates a timestamp greater than a fixed older timestamp.

methods.name: TestTimestampToDate
methods.description: Verifies the conversion of a timestamp to a date string.

methods.name: TestTimestampToDataStudioDatetime
methods.description: Checks the conversion of a timestamp to a Data Studio formatted datetime string.
